change.title: Migrate one-click checkpoints to the V2 runtime journal
change.summary: Migrates the existing eight one-click checkpoint sites from the V1 string-stage writer to typed V2 phases without moving their runtime timing. The first durable checkpoint freezes one candidate runtime fingerprint and one verified registered snapshot managed_id ticket; later phases, success clear, and binding commit require that same transaction identity. A first-write failure before protected mutation may enter existing compensation only through same-process PreJournalAbort with the in-memory registered ticket. Restarted ActiveRecovery without a journal remains manual, and the destructive-stop-before-durable-intent F5 gap is intentionally retained.

basis: the focused V2 identity covers all eight typed phases, first-write V1 replacement, immutable transaction id, candidate fingerprint and verified managed_id ticket, exact clear, and secret-free serialization

the isolated first-journal write fault uses a temporary HOME, fake Science identity, dynamic loopback ports, and the in-memory registered ticket to prove same-process PreJournalAbort compensation and prior Science restart
the existing crash-after-snapshot-before-journal characterization remains unchanged and continues to require manual recovery for ActiveRecovery without a journal
the source boundary binds exactly eight production V2 checkpoint calls and one candidate fingerprint derivation
